note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. A and B differ only in the supplied fact that, in B, sheet B receives no entry for the hand-off (a documentary gap); no consequence of the gap is drawn (nothing about custody, admissibility or validity), no winner and no score. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, scenarioA, scenarioB, changedFact, sharedFacts, comparisonLabels.
